variation.name: bir51_fs_hkfrs_baseline
variation.description: A minimal valid financial statements iXBRL data file for a BIR51 (corporation) filing using the IRD FS Taxonomy (full HKFRSs). Covers the four minimum tagging requirements: P&L / statement of comprehensive income, statement of financial position, notes — related party transactions, notes — PPE. Mandatory FS items present: Revenue, ProfitLossBeforeTax, TotalEquity. Balance sheet balances: TotalAssets = TotalEquityAndLiabilities.
